messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Contact and Conversation" as it appears in the following examples.
['To proceed with the application process, contact Professor [Name] on +1 (###) ###-#### via text message stating your full name, email address, year of study, and department to receive the job description and further application requirements.', 'Conclusively I wish you send me a reply immediately you receive this proposal.', 'At your request I will intimateyouwith the blueprint when I receive your mail.', 'Meanwhile, we are 100% positive that you can handle this therefore, contact me on +27-837466810 or E-mail: gillmbabane@yahoo.com as soon as you receive this urgent message.', 'Please if you are willing to assist me and my only son Francis, indicate your interest in replying soonest.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Contact me promptly by phone, text, or email to receive details, confirm your interest, or reply to my proposal and request for assistance."}
